description:
*The relationship between the man I’m going to marry and my friend feels suspicious.*

Yu-Ju, who has decided to marry her long-time lover. Before the most brilliant moment of her life, she decides to introduce her future boyfriend to her three close friends. However, after that meeting, suspicious circumstances between her lover and her friend begin to be detected, and Yu-Ju tries to resolve the suspicions, but the two only point fingers at each other and give conflicting explanations… 

Whose words are the truth, and whose fault is it? The truth that she finally witnesses ends up placing the responsibility on Yu-Ju. In front of the broken Yu-Ju, there is a female protagonist in the same situation as Yu-Ju on the screen. Women in the media who become pretty, take revenge, meet a better man, and eventually escape from their wounds forever and live a new life. If Yu-Ju does like them, will she be able to return to her happy self? Or is it all just a naive wish?

(Source: KakaoPage, translated)
